newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end up on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end up on positive sentiment.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher on Wednesday due to improved investor sentiment created by good interim results, brokers said.
The all share index closed 2.5 points up at 829.7. Development Finance rose 3.50 rupees to 320, John Keells Holdings 10 to 350.
"Good interim results are pulling the market up and volumes are also improving with every point the index rises," said Alistair Corera, of brokerage Forbes & Walker.
Turnover was 108.01 million rupees, led by 750,000 Asia Hotels, 179,400 Ceylon Brewery, 55,000 DFCC.
